en.tagline: Generate AI videos from text or images via the belt CLI
en.summary: This skill runs AI video models through the inference.sh belt CLI. It covers text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, video editing, lipsync, avatar animation, upscaling and sound effects, with about 40 models to choose from. It helps when you need a short video and want to run a model from the command line instead of setting up each model separately.
problem: You need a video for social media, marketing, an explainer or a product demo. Many video models exist, and each one fits different tasks, inputs and durations.
With this skill, you pick a model by its app ID and pass the inputs as JSON with `belt app run`. The skill lists the models, their app IDs and what each one is best for.
fit: Creating short videos from a text prompt
Animating a still image or making a talking-head clip with lipsync
Adding sound effects to a silent video or merging several clips
unfit: Tasks that do not use the belt CLI or an inference.sh account
Editing video by hand in a local video editor
steps: Choose a model from the tables by its app ID, such as `google/veo-3-1-fast`, or list video apps with `belt app list --category video`.
Run the model with `belt app run <app-id> --input '<json>'`, passing a prompt or an image or video URL.
Set model options such as `duration`, `resolution` or `generate_audio` where the model supports them.
Chain another tool if needed, for example `infsh/mmaudio` to add sound or `falai/topaz-video-upscaler` to upscale.

zh.tagline: 通过 belt 命令行生成 AI 视频
zh.summary: 这个技能通过 inference.sh 的 belt 命令行工具运行 AI 视频模型。它支持文生视频、图生视频、参考图生视频、视频编辑、口型同步、数字人动画、视频放大和音效生成，可选模型超过 40 个。当你需要一段短视频，并希望直接在命令行中运行模型，而不是逐个配置各家模型时，它会很有用。
problem: 你需要为社交媒体、营销、讲解或产品演示制作视频。可用的视频模型很多，每个模型适合的任务、输入和时长都不同。
使用这个技能后，你通过应用 ID 选择模型，用 `belt app run` 以 JSON 形式传入输入参数。技能中列出了各模型的应用 ID 以及它们最适合的场景。
fit: 根据文字提示词生成短视频
让静态图片动起来，或制作带口型同步的说话人视频
为无声视频添加音效，或把多段视频合并
unfit: 不使用 belt 命令行工具或 inference.sh 账号的任务
需要在本地视频编辑软件中手动剪辑的工作
steps: 从表格中按应用 ID 选择模型，例如 `google/veo-3-1-fast`，或用 `belt app list --category video` 列出视频应用。
用 `belt app run <app-id> --input '<json>'` 运行模型，传入提示词，或图片、视频的 URL。
如果模型支持，设置 `duration`、`resolution`、`generate_audio` 等选项。
如有需要，串联其他工具，例如用 `infsh/mmaudio` 添加声音，或用 `falai/topaz-video-upscaler` 提升画质。
